limitations: Only11 of1200 notes packages were manually inspected for this diagnostic; one confirmed family is a lower bound, not an exhaustive family count.
Uploader overlap statistics are metadata overlap, not proof of author identity or leakage.

The original grouped split has no existing group crossing and no pairs meeting its declared similarity thresholds; these facts are retained, with the stronger semantic-template limitation now evidenced.
A future independent confirmation set should group template families before freezing and prediction; do not retroactively alter this experiment.
Text similarity is heuristic; paraphrases, short notes and non-Latin text may evade grouping.
Whole-group partitioning does not prove independent authorship or eliminate broad taper-style overlap.

scope: Bounded postfreeze read-only split-integrity diagnostic. No regrouping, refreezing, label changes or new inference.

signature_overlap_diagnostic.description: Whitespace-normalized exact recording-chain line plus distinctive compilation-footer prefix, both in the same note. Public output omits the literal original strings. This mechanical signature is not a claim that all12 notes received full semantic template review.

verified_finding.basis: The three inspected notes share the same artist/venue/city/date header ordering, taper/source/transfer fields, a distinctive identical microphone/battery/filter/recorder source-chain block, tracklist and notes section ordering, and the same compilation/trading footer with variable date. Show-specific names, songs, commentary and equipment-output suffixes vary. This is direct shared-template evidence beyond common uploader identity or generic music vocabulary.
verified_finding.conclusion: At least one clearly related source-note template family crosses train, validation and test despite different frozen group IDs. Therefore the requirement to keep all related templates together was not fully achieved.
verified_finding.first_uploader_sample_outcome: Shared broad style and standard generated tables were observed, but this small sample alone does not establish an additional specific related-template family.
verified_finding.why_threshold_audit_did_not_flag: The implementation compares whole-package word shingles, including companion fingerprint files, identifiers, hashes and free prose. It erases numbered tracklist lines and numeric tokens but does not isolate reusable field/layout boilerplate or remove checksum/path material. The confirmed pairs have template Jaccard only0.071–0.109, far below0.90. Absence of threshold crossings is therefore compatible with this verified related-template overlap.
